operation.description: All operations requested for this PDF task. Choose extract_content for text, tables, images, or OCR; combine_or_split for merging or splitting files; rotate_pages for rotation; create_or_watermark for creating or watermarking; fill_forms for form completion; password_security for encryption or decryption. Multiple categories may apply; use an empty list if none is recognized.

source_kind.description: Known content type of the input PDF, relevant to extraction: text-based, scanned/image-only, or mixed. Use unknown if not known before acting.
